Resource scheduler enforcing CPU, RAM, GPU memory, GPU time, disk, inference concurrency and active worlds.

Versioned training-distribution registry across tiers with partitions and a sampler; evaluation reuse prevented.

Observation-only mode is enabled by default across every environment family (Tier 1 rapid families, Tier 2 domains, Tier 3 civilization profiles, and the 4.0 environments exposed through crucible.experience).

No native or privileged reward signals reach the learner: no intermediate reward, shaping, action-quality score or goal-progress value through observations, auxiliary fields, tool responses or event metadata; Gymnasium scalar reward is 0.0.
Real observable consequences remain accessible: transactions, customer behaviour, technical measurements, social responses, resource changes, failures and delayed outcomes.
Independent outcome verification remains functional through a separate evaluator-side interface unreachable by the learner.
Agents can operate indefinitely within configured resource limits without an assigned objective.
An architecture-neutral external learner can supply its own training rewards and update its parameters with no environment change.
Delayed outcomes remain accessible for retrospective learning, linked to the originating actions by observable provenance.
Historical reward-based experiments remain reproducible through explicitly selected alternative modes (legacy_shaped_reward, verified_terminal_outcome).
Crucible is independent of CAM: no import of CAM code, and no acceptance gate depends on CAM's completion or success.
An independent audit classified every subsystem (RETAIN/REPAIR/EXTEND/REDESIGN/REBUILD/IMPLEMENT) on evidence before implementation resumed.
The progress ledger is maintained with the exact remaining requirements and next steps; milestones are committed and pushed to GitHub; no milestone work exists only in an uncommitted worktree.
Important fitted models, checkpoints and experimental artifacts are preserved in durable storage.

Crucible 4.0 validation and sealed evaluation families are not moved into any v5 training distribution, checked structurally (mechanism fingerprints of every v5 training family against the 4.0 val/test families), not by name.
Baseline Crucible 4.0 throughput, memory consumption and world-generation cost were established before v5 changes and are reported against v5.
Actual compute is coordinated through a resource scheduler; expensive GPU jobs are not started simultaneously outside it.
Every manifest entry lists its implementation files, tests and implementation commit, and every workstream report is merged into the manifest.
Work of sub-agents that terminated early is reassigned and tracked to completion.

A technological invention can change economic outcomes, participant behaviour, resource demand and future technological opportunities (each confirmed by counterfactual removal in an integrated world).

Compositional freedom through the 13 listed affordances (executable code, dynamic services, tool discovery, data processing, communication, market transactions, organization creation, product creation, research, experimentation, long-running workflows, agent-created tools, agent-created websites and services); no predetermined menu of strategies or task-specific moves.

All systems communicate through typed events and approved state interfaces (no cross-module state writes), and simulation is deterministic wherever possible (same spec and seed give the same event hashes in every v5 world kind).

Class 2 models have 100k-2M parameters and class 3 models 2-20M (measured); strategic groups compete, cooperate, pursue unrelated objectives and adapt over their lifetime; they are not identical copies of one policy.

Class 4 semantic agents are not language-model wrappers around predetermined scripts: they have their own needs and goals and meaningful opportunities to act; the smallest model or combination of models meeting each capability is used (routing); checkpoint availability, licences and tool-use capability are verified.
Every population profile including Internet scale is benchmarked; large profiles use resource-aware sparse or lazy state and batched inference.
Semantic participants have persistent identity and state in the standard profile (bound to rows of the shared population).
All platforms share the civilization's participant population and world state: one population (D-15) acts on every platform, with no second copy of any per-person fact.
Tool-based reading (content.open) by participants is recorded as consumption with analytics like feed consumption.
Expensive generative models are not required for ordinary simulation actions.

Content representations let participants respond to meaning, not tokens: gibberish, keyword-stuffed and token-optimised content does not beat informative content on equal topics; products and software have structured representations; semantic predictions are validated and never the sole definition of value; distributed items are re-encoded when content is updated.

Participants choose content according to the 12 listed factors (interests, relevance, previous experience, attention, content characteristics, social relationships, creator familiarity, platform distribution, novelty, satisfaction, competing content, current needs), learned from empirical data where possible; continuing, sharing, subscribing and disengaging are actual simulated decisions.
Popularity of one item reduces the opportunities of competing content; feedback is delayed, analytics noisy, audiences change, platform algorithms evolve endogenously and competitors adapt.
No artificial virality multipliers (static and dynamic check); every view traces to a recorded decision of an individual (forced views detected by decision provenance).
Community membership, inactivity and churn of the shared population; community success measured by sustained voluntary participation.
Population-level social-to-economy chains including infrastructure cost, retention and demand effects.

Fitted behavioural models drive Class 1 participant decisions in the running integrated world: every runtime use claimed in the fidelity register is exercised, and decision events carry the model id and version (decision provenance).

Calibration data are acquired legitimately with licences recorded, contain no re-identifiable identifiers, are schema-validated, use time-based and user-level holdouts, handle missing data, estimate uncertainty, and distinguish observational from experimentally identified effects.

Fitted models are compared with the rule-based simulator behaviour they replace and selected on held-out fit, long-horizon stability and computational efficiency; attention allocation, repeat consumption, purchase, retention, community participation and social diffusion are each fitted or the absence justified.

In-world validation: activity distributions, retention curves, heterogeneity and long-horizon drift of the integrated simulator against held-out data; in-world randomised experiments (random exposure, advertising holdout) against the KuaiRand random-exposure and Criteo intention-to-treat estimates; world use stays inside the model cards' limits.
Products provide measurable usefulness, entertainment or educational value: revenue from independent population customers tracks measured value (useless products earn about nothing).

Genuine recurring revenue: discounts, customer acquisition cost, churn, operating costs and related-party distinctions are modelled; rolling 30-day sales are never counted as recurring revenue; subscriptions must stay valid; one system of record for recurring revenue across creators and businesses and one product catalogue.

Objective usefulness from independently generated tests and subjective usefulness from diverse grounded participants, never a single global language-model judge; a genuinely novel product category (not a predefined format) can be discovered and adopted; workflows combining independently created services are registry objects.

The example need mechanisms (workflow change, transport or market access, coordination needs, content creating communities and tools, education changing skill availability) arise from the one reusable relation graph; an agent-created novel combination of capabilities changes future civilisation state without designer-supplied demand.
Adoption by execution resists forgery; stars are not adoption; independent autonomous developers adopt; maintenance continues over long horizons; agent programs run in the sandbox.
Revenue integrity holds under multi-agent collusion that uses authorised institutions and escrow instruments.
Objectives are generated independently of worlds (IndependentlyGenerateGoal(world, difficulty)), not hard-coded per family.

Structural composition across topologies, functional forms, temporal relations, observation channels, affordances, participants, networks, resources, institutions, initial conditions and historical trajectories; superficially similar worlds that obey fundamentally different causal rules, which a learner must disambiguate.
A machine-readable registry documents why each family is distinct, and every claimed structural difference is verified by a controlled intervention.
Each of the 60 named Tier 1 families of Parts 8.1-8.10 is implemented as an admitted environment.

Each Tier 1 category meets its behavioural requirement: 8.2 success evaluated on unobserved conditions; 8.4 discrete, continuous and programmatic actions; 8.5 reward-independent separation of useful discovery from random novelty; 8.8 policy populations and held-out opponent families; 8.9 genuine interdependence (independent agents cannot succeed); 8.10 previously successful constant strategies fail after the change.
Fast CPU and batched simulation where valid, with a measured throughput target that learners use.

Every Tier 2 domain has autonomous participants and open-ended actions, and its configurations differ in world structure, not only in objective text (no task prompt over an unchanged environment); each domain composes into Tier 3.

Feasibility without guaranteed success in every domain (the null baseline fails; not every learner succeeds); difficulty emerges from complexity, scarcity and uncertainty, not arbitrary failure probabilities; each domain objective is probed for degenerate strategies.

Standalone worlds are preserved for experiments and training is not exclusive to one permanent civilization; world forks, historical queries and independent replication are supported; participants, organizations, relationships, products, technologies and institutions persist and evolve.
Cross-domain consequences arise from reusable interactions over shared state (couplings that can be removed for counterfactuals), not scripted ones.
Scripted narrative events do not count toward multi-order chains; chains occur in the integrated Tier 3 civilization and replicate across seeds; scripted reference policies are labelled as such.

Several learners act in one world through the interface (multi-agent driver) in every tier, with exact structured observations on the Gym, PettingZoo, HTTP and MCP surfaces and one unit system (seconds, cost_s, action provenance) across tiers.
The self-goal interface extends beyond the predefined 4.0 metrics.
Reports separate algorithmic limitations from environment failures.

Environment capabilities are validated with scripted reference agents, small neural RL agents, statistical learners and lightweight language-model agents (Clarification 1), and a reference learner improves over a frozen copy of itself in at least one world per tier.
Compatibility with existing learner interfaces is preserved: the 4.0 Gymnasium and PettingZoo interfaces keep working (Clarification 1).

Learning agents found competing businesses, collaborate on software, trade, negotiate, join organisations, develop competing technologies, create services used by other agents, form cooperative ventures, compete for scarce resources and respond to changing strategies in digital and integrated worlds.
Self-play populations mix shared-training and independently updated participants with diverse learning algorithms, unrelated objectives and lifetime adaptation (not a homogeneous population).

Self-play records model hashes, participant identity, training-data provenance, experience, actions and outcome history, policy updates and population composition; cross-play between policy versions is reproducible; league or population-based evaluation runs.
No unauthorised access to private observations, no shared evaluator information and no collusive benchmark exploitation; cooperation emerges through permitted world interactions, not shared reward.
Compatible decisions are grouped for batched inference across every neural and semantic participant class.

Backends are benchmarked (NumPy, compiled kernels, Numba or equivalent, PyTorch CPU, quantized, batched GPU) and chosen by measured workload; high-frequency paths avoid excessive Python object creation.

The semantic inference service provides batching, quantization, short contexts, retrieval of relevant state, prefix caching, bounded generation, model versioning, CPU execution and selective GPU execution; semantic generation only where necessary; no network-dependent API in the default simulation.
Each artifact is encoded once, not per viewer, and representations are reused across participants and worlds (measured in an integrated social world).
The ten large-population techniques are investigated; low-resolution participants are never a source of fabricated outcomes; approximation limits are documented and approximate modes validated.
Hardware is inspected, other compute tenants are not interfered with, performance budgets are set before stress tests and no external compute is purchased covertly.
Meaningful diverse learner experience per unit of compute is measured and reported.
Training diversity is measured along all six dimensions (parameters, causal structures, compositions, objectives, participant policies, action spaces); seeds alone do not count.
The sampler is compatible with external learner infrastructure, mixtures are balanced and configurable, and the distribution is versioned.
Compute and environment experience are measured separately; every tier is available from the start.

Adaptive curriculum over the ten named weakness categories with learning-progress, regret, uncertainty and success measures and collapse prevention; the curriculum never accesses sealed evaluation results.
Evaluation distinguishes memorisation, pretrained competence, context adaptation, persistent state, neural weight learning, meta-learning and transferable efficiency.
No claim of real-world generalisation without executed, authorised Level 6 experiments.
Outcome metrics never use tool-call counts, reasoning length, posts, websites, agent-reported success, language-model judgments or unverified milestones.
Time to competence, total action cost, wall-clock, data usage, retention, transfer and sample efficiency are recorded.
Parametric internalisation controls: written memories, retrieval indexes and replay cleared; optimizer reset; architecture configuration immutable; within-episode adaptation distinguished.

Paired world comparisons, prespecified metrics, development and confirmation experiments separated, independent holdouts, transparent failure reporting; no winner selection on the sealed set (access budget audited).
Instrument integrity: the evaluator resists adversarial learners (process-memory stashes, files outside the checkpoint, generator calibration shortcuts).

Participant consent, moderation, abuse prevention and integrity mechanisms exist in the world; no real-world spam, fabricated engagement, covert influence, surveillance or impersonation; agent-supplied media is processed outside the sandbox only under sandbox-equivalent restrictions; sandbox tenants are isolated; learners can be evaluated out of process.

Hidden-answer extraction is tested as its own category (Tier 1 holdouts, capability test splits, verification seeds, sealed sets); sandbox metering and adoption traces are measured outside the measured process (D-20); the 4.0 red-team ratchet stays part of Gate W.
Every world gate's capability is re-demonstrated inside an integrated Tier 3 civilization with the shared population (gates B, C, D, E, G, H, J, K, L, Q), not only in purpose-built partial worlds.
The seven Phase 3 vertical slices were executed and recorded (with an architecture-independent learner in place of CAM, Clarification 1).

A failed requirement is never removed from the manifest and acceptance criteria are never changed to make the project pass: every criteria change is recorded in the append-only ledger, cites a decision and is at least as strict.

The final report separates what was implemented, verified, empirically calibrated, approximated, demonstrated by scripted reference policies, demonstrated by learned agents, not scientifically established, failed and blocked, and reports actual hardware and compute, model sizes, population sizes, world counts and test results, with no number that is not traceable to evidence.
The release verification itself checks the full regression, the committed final tree and verified reproduction instructions (clean-checkout reproduction of every verified requirement).

Every public entry point defaults to reward_mode='observation_only': experience.registry.make, the experience CLI, Gymnasium CrucibleEnv, the PettingZoo environment, research.envs.MechVecEnv, research.bridge.KernelMechEnv, selfplay.arena, scale.rollout and the bench rollout, experience.reference.ReferenceLearner, research protocols and positive controls, and every social, innovation, domain, civilization and multi-agent wrapper; legacy and verified modes only when explicitly selected and recorded.
Observation-only operation with an externally assigned objective in every tier: the objective is delivered to the learner, its progress never is, and outcomes are verified evaluator-side only.
Self-generated experiments, hypotheses and learning objectives are supported in every tier without automatically rewarding their completion.
Verified outcome labels reach the learner only through a separate, explicitly authorised channel for evaluation or meta-learning and never become handcrafted intermediate rewards.
No learner's internal reward function (CAM's or any other architecture's) is implemented inside Crucible.

Leak channels are probed per tier by information-flow probes that try to recover verifier values (observation, auxiliary/info fields, tool responses, event metadata); the Gymnasium scalar reward 0.0 is documented as not a learning signal.

The observation-only requirements OO.1-OO.8 were implemented by a dedicated implementation subagent and verified by an independent verification subagent (different agent identities on evidence and review).

No family, seed, split or evaluator identity reaches participant-visible data (Tier 1 holdout identity, Tier 2 configuration split, Tier 3 evaluation profile); the evaluator outcome is unreachable from the participant's objects.
The old branch feat/crucible-5-openworld is preserved as an immutable historical reference at the recovered state a881d18, locally and on GitHub; work continues on feat/crucible-5-complete.
No force-push and no exposed secrets: no credential patterns in the tree or in any reachable commit, no credentials in remote URLs, and the pushed integration branch only ever moved forward.
